title: General CounterCheck CounterCheckResponse
text: The counter check procedure is used by the network to request the UE to verify the amount of data sent/ received on each DRB. More specifically, the UE is requested to check if, for each DRB, the most significant bits of the COUNT match with the values indicated by the network.
NOTE: The procedure enables the network to detect packet insertion by an intruder (a 'man in the middle').
